profile.headline: Software Engineer, Graphic designer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer focused on architectural purity and AI-driven efficiency. I have a track record of taking fragmented, legacy environments and rebuilding them into modern, performant platforms that drive business value.

I believe in moving fast without breaking things, using strict type safety and AI-assisted testing to ensure 100% reliability in production. From developing cross-platform marketplaces to engineering data-heavy healthcare applications, I build for scale and longevity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed full-stack web applications across multiple platforms
• Maintained Git/GitHub individual and team repositories with detailed documentation
• Modern JavaScript, Node, React, MongoDB, Express, GitHub, API applications, CSS3, & HTML5

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Advise clients on the best strategies to use for their particular products and desired audiences.
• Create unique images, video posts, & logos for customers.
• Created style guides and marketing templates for new companies being launched.

projects.title: Recipe API Site
projects.description: A single page app where users can browse the Tasty API for recipes by ingredients . Users can view videos and list of ingredients.

projects.title: Kit10 - Store
projects.description:
Kit 10 is an e-commerce site with retro sports gear. Users can
select to add items to their cart, erase or add more items to purchase.

• Built a Carousel with Bootstrap
• Applied Context API for storing data
• Styled application with Styled-Components and Bootstrap
• React JS using hooks
